prompt:
Retouch the reference photograph. His face, his hair, his expression, his gaze
towards the left of the picture, the framing, the camera height and the warm
light of the hall stay exactly as they are.

Two things change. Where the wooden counter stood in the lower part of the
picture, his grey jacket and blue jeans simply continue down to the bottom
edge, and his hand that rested on the counter now hangs open and empty at his
side. The dark blurred shoulder in the left foreground becomes the shoulder of
a beige trench coat, as blurred and as large as before.
